title: Served partitions are read one at a time: no authorized union across a principal's grants yet
observation: A served read was scoped to ONE partition: a principal granted several drawers had to call read once per partition, and denied_scopes only named scopes of records found in the queried partition's store. The roadmap's 'served graph is the authorized union of partitions' was therefore not true at the read verb. Resolved by the union read: ReadRequest.scopes reads every granted partition the server hosts in one call and merges the state of record, with per-ref scope, per-partition receipts and ungranted scopes named in denied_scopes.
evidence: test/serve.test.ts: a service principal granted two partitions reads both in one call (receipts 2, scopes 2, denied_scopes []); an agent granted one gets that one with the other named in denied_scopes, status 200
src/serve/app.ts /nuryel/v1/read merges via mergeReadResponses in src/store/stateBinding.ts
